pkgmetadata.longdescription: Prebuilt biliup command line tool. It records live streams from bilibili, douyu, huya, twitch and youtube, uploads videos to bilibili with multi-part and line selection support, and can run a web interface with the server subcommand. Successor of net-misc/biliup-rs, which upstream archived.
biliup 命令行工具的预编译版本。支持录制 bilibili、斗鱼、虎牙、twitch、 youtube 的直播，投稿到 B 站时支持多 p 和上传线路选择，server 子命令可以 启动网页界面。上游已封存的 net-misc/biliup-rs 的后继者。
